name: Spider-Man 2099

abilityDetails.Dodge: Gelen bir temel saldırıdan veya temaslı özel saldırıdan geriye kaçarak kaçınma; Çeviklik ustalığı bu pencereyi genişletir.
abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Resistance Up: Fiziksel Direnci ve Enerji Direncini belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.

howToPlay: Spider-Man 2099 için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Persistent Ruptures
Ruptures have [10 - 80]% chance to not be consumed when a Burst of Physical Damage triggers.
+[5 - 25]% Combat Power Rate while the Opponent is affected by a Wither Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Spider-Man 2099 is immune to Buffs. Whenever a Buff is prevented by immunity he instead pauses his personal Debuffs for 5 second(s). Personal Stun Debuffs cannot be paused.
While Dodging backward, Spider-Man 2099 is not struck by attacks. Dodging an attack this way triggers his Debuff pausing ability.
Gain 75% Damage Resistance if the Opponent is under the effect of True Strike or if the hit deals True Damage.

abilitySections.title: Rupture - 20 Stacks
content: Light and Medium attacks have 25% chance to inflict Rupture, dealing [2,190] Physical Damage over 10 second(s). 100% chance to inflict Rupture on a block if the Opponent is suffering from a Wither Debuff.
An Opponent takes a Burst of [3,285] Physical Damage for each Rupture on them if they reach zero power or when they gain a bar of Power. Ruptures are consumed after this effect takes place.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Inflict an Exhaustion Debuff, decreasing Critical Damage Rating by [80.1] and the potency of their Power Gain effects by 15% for 15 second(s). Max 5 stacks.

abilitySections.title: Resistance Up - Max 100 stacks
content: When attacked there is a 100% chance to gain an indefinite [114.58] Resistance Up Passive.

Interrupting Spider-Man 2099 while he is charging a Heavy Attack removes all Resistance Up stacks. If at least 20 stacks were removed this way, he inflicts a Wither Debuff with a potency of 125% for 20 second(s).
When Spider-Man 2099 pauses his personal Debuffs, he consumes 5 stacks of Resistance Up and increases the pause duration by 5 second(s). This effect has a 10 second(s) cooldown.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Last three hits have 100% chance to inflict Physical Vulnerability Debuff, decreasing Physical Resistance by [305.56] for 15 second(s). Max 15 stacks
On activation gain 15 stacks of Resistance Up Passive, increasing Physical Resistance and Energy Resistance by [114.58].

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation inflicts a Wither Debuff with a potency of 125% for 15 second(s). Max 5 stacks.
Each hit deals a Burst of [4,106.25] Physical Damage per Unique Debuff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Stun Debuff for 4 second(s).
Inflict a Slow Debuff, lasting 25 second(s). Slow counts as 4 Unique Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Persistent Ruptures
content: Ruptures have [10 - 80]% chance to not be consumed when a Burst of Physical Damage triggers.
+[5 - 25]% Combat Power Rate while the Opponent is affected by a Wither Debuff.
